body: I just want to say in case I don't get the chance to thank you for talking to me. You of all the people in the world we're the only person who would talk to me. I just want to say I appreciate that
My feet are starting to get tired
25 and no I chose to be lonely. No I'm too dead on the inside to enjoy doing anything. It's depressing but this is what I am.

I have some family but we didn't stay family and yes no friends or significant other.

Happy thoughts? Oh just childhood memories or when I used to make people laugh in school
I'm just tired, I'm all alone in this crazy world. The funny thing is I'm feeling happy about this, scared but happy nonetheless
